Jonas / team / Melissa —

Thanks for the context and for the VAT certificate. I've reviewed the account health and recent usage patterns. Recommendation from leadership: accept the 60/40 staggered remit on the following terms —

1) No late fee if first tranche (60%) is received and confirmed by 2027-03-12 COB (bank trace required).
2) Second tranche (40%) due 2027-03-26 COB. Failure to meet either milestone triggers immediate credit hold and referral to collections.
3) NutriFlow must provide a copy of the payment confirmation (SWIFT/CHAPS/SEPA trace) for the first tranche before we resume increased rate limits or dedicated capacity.
4) Redwood will not grant any additional credit or discounts beyond these dates.

Please confirm acceptance of these terms and attach the payment trace once the first transfer is sent. Once we receive confirmation of the first payment, Kimberly will update the ledger and remove the hold.

Melissa — appreciate your cooperation and quick follow-through.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations (on behalf of leadership)
